name: 56201 · Willmar, MN
findings: ZIP 56201 (Willmar) has 109 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 39 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 56201 (Willmar) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 56201 (Willmar) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 39 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
